task2.prompt: Some people believe that working from home is better for both employees and employers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that universities should focus on preparing students for employment, while others believe their main purpose is to give students knowledge for its own sake. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
International tourism has grown rapidly in recent decades. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
In many countries, the number of children who are overweight is increasing. What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to solve it?
More and more people are moving from the countryside to large cities. Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?
Children today spend too much time on screens and too little time playing outdoors. Parents, not schools, should be responsible for changing this. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that the government should be responsible for looking after elderly people, while others believe this is the responsibility of their families. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Advertising aimed at children should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
In some countries, children start learning a foreign language at primary school. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Traffic congestion is becoming a serious problem in many large cities. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
Museums and art galleries should be free for everyone to visit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe that spending money on space exploration is a waste, while others think it brings important benefits to humanity. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
More and more students are taking courses online rather than attending classes in person. Do the advantages of online learning outweigh the disadvantages?
The best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
The amount of plastic waste produced by households is increasing. Why is this happening, and what can be done to reduce it?
Many young people take a year off between finishing school and starting university, often to travel or work. Why do they do this? Is it a good idea?

task1.prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of commuters using four types of transport in one city in 2005 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The graph below shows the share of electricity generated from coal, gas and renewable sources in one country between 2000 and 2030 (projected). Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The table below shows how much an average household spent each week on five categories in three countries in 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The chart below shows the number of visits to a public library, by age group, in 2014 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The graph below shows average daily water use per person in three cities from 1995 to 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The table below shows the number of international students at four universities, and the percentage of them studying science subjects, in 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

letters.prompt: Your neighbour has recently started building work on their house, and the noise is causing problems for you. Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter: describe the problems the noise is causing; explain when the noise is most difficult for you; suggest what could be done about the situation. Begin your letter as follows: Dear ...,

You recently attended an evening course at a local college, but you were not satisfied with it. Write a letter to the college manager. In your letter: give details of the course you attended; explain what was unsatisfactory; say what you would like the college to do. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,

A friend from another country is planning to visit your city for a week and has asked for your advice. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: suggest the best time of year to visit; recommend some places to see; give advice about getting around the city. Begin your letter as follows: Dear ...,

You have seen an advertisement for a part-time job at a local museum. Write a letter to the museum manager. In your letter: explain why you are interested in the job; describe your relevant experience; say when you would be available to work. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,
